slug: 2025-03-25 Somalia taps BPC to launch first nationwide instant payment system

SOM.note: Document does not mention public procurement.

facts.fact: The Somalia Instant Payment System, operated by Somalia Payment Switch under the Central Bank of Somalia, launched in January 2025 with the central bank acting as clearing and settlement agent and seven institutions connected, per FinTech Futures.

systems.owner: Somalia Payment Switch, under Central Bank of Somalia

SOM.note: A fraud management tool is mentioned but no consumer rules or redress.
No government payments to people stated.
No survey share of adults with an account stated.

facts.fact: The Somalia Instant Payment System, live since January 2025, lets consumers make instant transfers from a mobile or banking app and QR payments, with seven institutions connected and SOMQR (2023) routing contactless payments, per FinTech Futures.

SOM.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
